# Vendored assets

Everything in this directory ships with Conway so the app makes no external
requests at runtime. Licenses are permissive (MIT / SIL OFL 1.1) and the
license texts sit beside the assets they cover.

| Path | What | License |
|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css` | Bootstrap v5.3.8 compiled CSS | MIT — see `bootstrap/LICENSE` |
| `bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` | Bootstrap v5.3.8 JS + Popper | MIT — see `bootstrap/LICENSE` |
| `fonts/public-sans-*.woff2` | Public Sans (variable, 400-700), latin | SIL OFL 1.1 — see `fonts/OFL-PublicSans.txt` (GSA modifications additionally CC0) |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-mono-*.woff2` | IBM Plex Mono 400/500, latin | SIL OFL 1.1 — see `fonts/OFL-IBMPlexMono.txt` |

Fetched 2026-08-23 from jsdelivr (Bootstrap) and fonts.gstatic.com (fonts, via
the Google Fonts API). Unmodified.
